mail/pop3#

POP3 values (RFC 1939, RFC 2449): message numbers, unique ids, listings and capabilities.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

let listing = await session.messages();
for listing -> message {
    message.number().number();
    message.size();
    if message.identified() { message.identifier().string(); }     // UIDL
}

Description#

POP3 values (RFC 1939, RFC 2449): message numbers, unique ids, listings and capabilities.

A number is a position in this session; a UIDL id is stable in the maildrop. Neither is a Message-ID. Listings are bounded: 4096 messages by default.
